description: Consumer fixtures for rows published from evidence bundles (scripts/aggregate.mjs --from-bundles, docs/WEBSITE-HANDOFF.md). They are the producer's real output for a SYNTHETIC scenario: bundles built from the app-emitted test fixtures, published into a board holding one vendor row and two July 2026 rows without versions, under a fixture configs/board.json whose llama.cpp and LiteRT-LM sets are the fixture sessions' versions. data/benchmarks.json holds only displayed rows; every other row and session is in the sessions file. Evidence URLs name the fixture bundles' real hashes but do not resolve. tests/test_bundle_publication.py regenerates every file and fails while one differs. Every file is producer-valid (producerMustNotEmit false). The fixture sessions run synthetic copies of cpu-reference-v2 (protocol cpu-reference-v3), so configurationId cpu-reference-v2 appears with a different configurationSha256 per scenario; each hash names its own fixture file, not the committed configuration.
scenario: Google Pixel 9 / Llama 3.2 1B Q4_K_M: a verified session replaces the July 2026 row (--replace-legacy, kept in replacedRows); a newer failed session stays in the history and is not displayed
Google Fixture Phone / Llama 3.2 1B Q4_K_M: unverified (the configured run pins no model hash)
Google Fixture Tablet / Llama 3.2 1B Q4_K_M: its only session failed (interrupted repetition), so the key is in the sessions file only and data/benchmarks.json has no row for it
Google Fixture Phone / Gemma 3 1B Q4_0 (GGUF), llama.cpp NPU: verified (accelerator-v2, gate pass, backend confirmed)
the vendor row and the ExecuTorch Pixel 9 July 2026 row (no versions, sourceDate 2026-07, dateBasis measured) are unchanged

fixtures.consumerExpectation: rendered: every row; engine and binding versions shown as text on each measured row that has them; the July 2026 row shows its month and no version; the vendor row in the Vendor-reported section; no 'legacy' or 'failed' wording
optional: history links per row key; a displayed session equals its board row; a key with displayed null has no board row
